quantity: Linear sRGB (D65) of Saturn's disc in sunlight, divided by the luminance of the sunlight; only the channel ratios are used.

spectrum.product: 1995LOW.TAB, PDS volume GBAT_0001, data set ESO-J/S/N/U-SPECTROPHOTOMETER-4-V2.0
spectrum.column: SATURN ALBEDO (column 5): full disk albedo of Saturn at phase angle 5.7 deg and zero ring tilt, European Southern Observatory Boller & Chivens spectrograph, 1995-07-06 to 1995-07-10
spectrum.wavelength: AIR WAVELENGTH (column 2), linearly interpolated onto 380-780 nm at 1 nm

illuminant.spectrum: Planck, 5772 K: the Sun's effective temperature in NASA's Sun fact sheet, the temperature of the lane's solar tint

observer: CIE 1931 2 degree colour-matching functions (tools/references/reference-bank.mts), summed at 1 nm and converted with the IEC 61966-2-1 XYZ-to-linear-sRGB matrix, as spectrumLinearSrgb in tools/objects/observation/stellar/stellar-photometric-color.mts
